```python
def priority_v1(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    bins = np.asarray(bins, dtype=float)
    residual = bins - item
    residual = np.where(residual >= 0, residual, 0.0)
    used = np.where(bins > 0, 1.0, 0.0)
    waste = residual
    waste_penalty = waste * (1.0 + 0.1 * used)
    fit_score = -waste_penalty
    diversity = np.where(residual > 0, 1.0 / (residual + 1e-9), 0.0)
    score = fit_score + 0.5 * diversity
    return score
```

```python
def priority_v1(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    bins = np.asarray(bins, dtype=float)
    residual = bins - item
    valid = residual >= 0
    if not np.any(valid):
        return np.zeros_like(bins, dtype=float)
    valid_residual = np.where(valid, residual, np.inf)
    min_residual = np.min(valid_residual)
    max_residual = np.max(np.where(valid, residual, 0.0))
    if max_residual <= 0.0:
        return np.where(valid, 1.0, -np.inf)
    norm = (residual - min_residual) / (max_residual - min_residual)
    norm = np.where(valid, norm, -np.inf)
    waste = residual
    waste_norm = waste / max_residual
    waste_norm = np.where(valid, waste_norm, -np.inf)
    score = norm - 0.5 * waste_norm
    score = np.where(valid, score, -np.inf)
    return score
```

```python
def priority_v1(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    bins = np.asarray(bins, dtype=float)
    residual = bins - item
    positive = residual > 0
    if not np.any(positive):
        return np.zeros_like(bins)
    pos_res = np.where(positive, residual, 1.0)
    pos_bins = np.where(positive, bins, 1.0)
    ratio = item / pos_bins
    log_term = np.log(ratio)
    waste = pos_res
    fill = 1.0 - ratio
    score = np.where(positive, fill * 10.0 - log_term - waste * 0.1, -np.inf)
    return score
```

```python
def priority_v1(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    bins = np.asarray(bins, dtype=float)
    residual = bins - item
    used = residual > 0
    empty = residual == 0
    item_f = float(item)
    max_res = np.max(residual)
    if max_res <= 0:
        return np.zeros_like(bins)
    norm = residual / max_res
    fit_score = np.where(used, norm, 0.0)
    empty_bonus = np.where(empty, 1.0, 0.0)
    small_item = item_f < 0.5
    if small_item:
        weights = np.where(used, 1.0, 0.0)
        scores = weights * (0.5 + 0.5 * norm) + empty_bonus * 0.1
    else:
        scores = fit_score + empty_bonus * 0.05
    scores = np.where(used, scores, -1e9)
    return scores
```

```python
def priority_v1(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    bins = np.asarray(bins, dtype=float)
    residual = bins - item
    valid = residual >= 0
    if not np.any(valid):
        return np.zeros_like(bins)
    valid_residual = residual[valid]
    valid_bins = bins[valid]
    mean_residual = np.mean(valid_residual)
    std_residual = np.std(valid_residual)
    if std_residual < 1e-12:
        z_scores = np.zeros_like(valid_residual)
    else:
        z_scores = (valid_residual - mean_residual) / std_residual
    item_ratio = item / np.where(valid_bins > 0, valid_bins, 1.0)
    waste_penalty = item_ratio * 0.5
    scores = z_scores - waste_penalty
    result = np.full_like(bins, -1e18)
    result[valid] = scores
    return result
```
